title: Scripture and Prayer
definition: Scripture and prayer belong together because God speaks through His Word and His people respond to Him in dependence, worship, confession, and request.
summary: Prayerful Bible reading receives God's Word and responds back to Him.
christFocus: Jesus teaches His disciples to abide in His words and come to the Father in prayer.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture and prayer form a holy conversation. In Scripture, God speaks. In prayer, believers respond with worship, confession, thanksgiving, trust, and petition.

Prayer keeps Bible study from becoming cold information. Scripture keeps prayer from becoming untethered emotion or self-centered desire. Together they shape communion with God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many believers either read without prayer or pray without Scripture. This doctrine matters because spiritual life needs both God's voice in the Word and the believer's dependent response.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pray Scripture back to God. Before reading, ask for understanding. After reading, respond with confession, thanksgiving, worship, and obedience.
